mechanism.what: span-audited deterministic rewrites of closed Vietnamese constructions into canonical forms that the local parser and the Source Gate already read and verify; every step records rule id, original span and evidence; conditional / negated sentences are blocked by _apply_safe_sub, yes/no questions and failed preconditions leave the text unchanged
mechanism.when_it_runs: only when the deterministic parser does not complete the ORIGINAL text; the canonical text then goes to the parser (LOCAL_PARSER_AFTER_V3_NORMALIZER) and, if still incomplete, to AxoV9
mechanism.source_gate_authority: unchanged in strictness: the Source Gate verifies the canonical text with the same closed grammar as typed input; it does not read the original wording, so each rewrite rule is itself a trusted step and carries a no-fire test set
mechanism.not_done: no new parser framework, no model change, no fine-tuning, no OCR/Vision work
